title: The integral transition is uniquely specified on every positive quotient twist.
statement:
Let $X$ be any scheme, $\ell$ a prime, and $E\subseteq F\subseteq\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ finite intermediate extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with valuation rings $\mathcal O_E,\mathcal O_F$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the small pro-etale site and coefficient universe of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. The coefficients $R_G=\mathcal O_{G,X}$, for $G=E,F$, are the pulled-back continuous-function condensed ring objects [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. For $n\geq0$, write $B_{G,n}=\mathcal O_G/\ell^{n+1}\mathcal O_G$ with its discrete topology, and $B_{G,n,X}=p_X^*\underline{B_{G,n}}$. Let $q_{G,n}:R_G\to B_{G,n,X}$ and $r_{G,n}:B_{G,n+1,X}\to B_{G,n,X}$ be the pulled-back quotient reductions, continuous before pullback by [lem-sp-ell-quotient-finite-discrete]. Let $i:R_E\to R_F$ be the unique integral coefficient map over $E_X\to F_X$ of [lem-route-sp-integers-map-exists-unique], and let $j_n:B_{E,n,X}\to B_{F,n,X}$ be the unique map satisfying $j_nq_{E,n}=q_{F,n}i$ of [lem-route-sp-ell-map-exists-unique]. Composition here is in the usual functional order.

Put $U_n=\mu_{\ell^{n+1},X}$, with $v_n:U_{n+1}\to U_n$, $u\mapsto u^\ell$, as in [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf]. In the category of internal $R_G$-modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], let $T_{G,n}$ have underlying abelian sheaf $B_{G,n,X}\otimes_{\mathbf Z}U_n$ [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor], with $R_G$ acting on the first factor through $q_{G,n}$. Use the unique module transition with underlying arrow $r_{G,n}\otimes v_n$ of [lem-sp-integral-level-transition-unique]. Let $L_G=\varprojlim_{n\in\mathbf N^{\mathrm{op}}}T_{G,n}$ in internal $R_G$-modules, and write $p_{G,n}:|L_G|\to B_{G,n,X}\otimes_{\mathbf Z}U_n$ for its underlying projections, where vertical bars forget the module action [def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit, def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. Then there exists exactly one morphism of abelian sheaves $f:|L_E|\to|L_F|$ such that
$$
 p_{F,n}\circ f=(j_n\otimes\mathrm{id}_{U_n})\circ p_{E,n}\qquad(n\geq0).
$$
This is the assertion for the specified systems spIntegralTwistSystem and their limits spIntegralTwist. No invertibility of $\ell$ on $X$ is assumed, and the conclusion specifies an underlying abelian-sheaf morphism, with no additional linearity assertion.

proof.text: Use the existing normalized finite quotient maps j_n of [lem-route-sp-ell-map-exists-unique]. Their square with each coefficient reduction commutes by that theorem. Successive quotient reductions compose to the lower reduction by the quotient factor formula [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring-map, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Each coefficient reduction is epimorphic: on profinite tests, choose representatives of each discrete quotient value; the resulting map from the discrete quotient to the valuation ring is continuous, and composition lifts every continuous quotient-valued section. The left adjoint p_X^* preserves this epimorphism [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point]. Cancel the source reduction to obtain commutation of j_n with successive coefficient reductions.

proof.text: The forgetful functor from internal modules creates and preserves limits. Postcompose the source limiting cone by the preceding natural transformation. Lift this cone uniquely through the underlying target limit. Its factorization equations are exactly the required finite projection formulas. If another map has those formulas, limit hom_ext identifies it with this lift. This is the categorical universal property of the specified inverse limit [def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit], without passage through sectionwise module equivalences.

    (h : E ≤ F) :
    ∃! f : (spIntegralTwist X ℓ E).X ⟶ (spIntegralTwist X ℓ F).X,
      ∀ n : ℕ, f ≫ (limit.π (spIntegralTwistSystem X ℓ F) (op n)).hom =
        (limit.π (spIntegralTwistSystem X ℓ E) (op n)).hom ≫
          (spEllMap X ℓ h n ⊗ₘ
            𝟙 (Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnitySheaf X (ℓ ^ (n + 1)))) := by
